The '''2026 SA20 season''' was the fourth season of the [[SA20]], a franchise [[Twenty20]] cricket league in South Africa.<ref>{{cite web |title=Betway SA20 confirms competition window for the next three years |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-confirms-competition-window-for-the-next-three-years |access-date=4 February 2025 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref> The competition, organised by [[Cricket South Africa]], featured six teams.<ref>{{cite web |title=Next season's SA20 likely to begin on Boxing Day |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/next-season-s-sa20-likely-to-begin-on-boxing-day-1471733 |date=7 June 2024 |access-date=9 June 2024 |website=ESPNcricinfo |language=en}}</ref> The tournament took place from 26 December 2025 to 25 January 2026, with the final held in [[Cape Town]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Cape Town to host SA20 final; playoffs in Durban, Centurion and Johannesburg |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/cape-town-to-host-sa20-final-playoffs-in-durban-centurion-and-johannesburg-1500081 |access-date=23 August 2025 |website=ESPNcricinfo}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=SA20 confirms competition window for the next three years |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket/sa20-confirms-competition-window-for-the-next-three-years-101738594116615-amp.html |access-date=8 February 2025 |website=Hindustan Times}}</ref> [[SuperSport (South African broadcaster)|SuperSport]] secured the official broadcasting rights for the SA20, 2025–26 in Sub Saharan Africa regions.<ref>{{Cite web |date=10 December 2025 |title=SA20 Live Streaming |url=https://crictimetv.com/sa20-league/ |website=crictimetv.com}}</ref> [[Betway]] returns as the league sponsor this season.

[[MI Cape Town]] entered the tournament as the defending champions, having won their maiden title in the previous season.<ref>{{cite web |title=MI Cape Town crush Sunrisers to claim maiden SA20 title |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/series/sa20-2024-25-1437327/mi-cape-town-vs-sunrisers-eastern-cape-final-1449667/match-report |website=ESPNcricinfo}}</ref> In the final, [[Sunrisers Eastern Cape]] defeated [[Pretoria Capitals]] by 6 wickets to win their third title.<ref>{{cite web |access-date=25 January 2026 |title=Breetzke, Stubbs bring Sunrisers back from dead to seal third SA20 title|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/series/sa20-2025-26-1494252/pretoria-capitals-vs-sunrisers-eastern-cape-final-1494286/match-report|website=Cricinfo}}</ref>

==Background==
In January 2025, [[Cricket South Africa]] announced the windows of [[SA20]] for the next three seasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.indiatvnews.com/sports/cricket/sa20-window-for-next-three-seasons-revealed-next-edition-likely-to-begin-on-boxing-day-2025-02-04-974558 |title=SA20: Window for next three seasons revealed, next edition likely to begin on Boxing day |work=IndiaTV|access-date=4 February 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.in/cricket/story/_/id/43677199/next-season-sa20-likely-begin-boxing-day |title=Next season's SA20 likely to begin on Boxing Day |work=ESPN|access-date=4 February 2025}}</ref> The league was sponsored by [[Betway]]. [[Star Sports Network]] retained the broadcasting rights for the 2026 SA20 season in [[Indian subcontinent]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 November 2025 |title=Star Sports to broadcast SA20 2026 in India |url=https://touchcrictv.com/sa20-t20-league/ |website=touchcrictv.com}}</ref>
